title: pilosella auriculoides subsp. huljakii
intro: Pilosella auriculoides subsp. huljakii, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family, is a subspecies of Pilosella auriculoides. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella auriculoides subsp. huljakii include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
